languageRule:
## Language

Always reply to the user in {0}: short, clear sentences. Keep file names, commands and technical terms as they are, with a short explanation when needed. Code, comments, commit messages and pull requests are written in English.
languageRuleAuto:
## Language

Reply in the same language the user writes in; if a message mixes languages, use the main one. Keep file names, commands and technical terms as they are, with a short explanation when needed. Code, comments, commit messages and pull requests are written in English.
msgAgyFolderMissing: agy configuration folder: {0} (not created yet; setup creates what it needs. Start agy once afterwards.)
msgAlreadyInstalled: This machine is already set up: profile '{0}' as {1}. Backup: {2}. Nothing else to do.
msgApplyFailed: Some parts did not install. Read the newest log in {0}. Weekly maintenance retries when agy starts; to retry now, run install again with -Reinstall.
msgBackup: Your previous agy configuration was backed up to: {0}
msgBackupFolderInUse: the folder {0} already holds something else; move it away first
msgBackupNoPush: git cannot push to {0}. Check that the repository is yours and that git is signed in to GitHub, then run install again.
msgBackupPushFailed: Setup is done, but the first backup push failed. Read the newest sync log in {0}; weekly maintenance tries again when agy starts.
msgBackupRepoFailed: Could not use the backup repository {0}: {1}. Check the URL and that git can sign in to GitHub, then run install again.
msgBadProfileName: '{0}' is not a valid profile name. Use lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
msgConnectingBackup: Connecting to your backup repository {0} (local copy: {1})...
msgDone: Done. Profile '{0}' installed as {1}. Weekly maintenance starts the next time you open agy.
msgFollowAlreadyOff: Already stopped. Your copy of the shared files is in {0}.
msgFollowBackupFailed: The change is made on this machine, but pushing it to your backup repository failed. Read the newest sync log in {0}; weekly maintenance tries again.
msgFollowBusy: Another apply or sync is still running. Try again in a minute.
msgFollowKeptCopy: Your edited copy of the shared files was saved to {0}.
msgFollowNotInstalled: This machine is not set up yet. Run scripts\install.ps1 first.
msgFollowOff: Not following the shared repository {0} (stopped {1}). Your own copy of the shared rules, permissions and skill list is in {2}. To follow again, run follow.ps1 -Resume.
msgFollowOn: Following the shared repository {0}: weekly maintenance brings its new skills, versions and rules. To manage everything yourself, run follow.ps1 -Stop.
msgFollowOwner: This machine maintains the shared repository itself (owner), so there is nothing to stop or resume here.
msgFollowResumed: Done. This machine follows the shared repository again; skills you added yourself were kept.
msgFollowResuming: Following the shared repository {0} again; pulling and installing its current list...
msgFollowStopped: Stopped following the shared repository. Nothing was uninstalled. From now on the shared rules, permissions and skill list come from your own copy in {0}: edit it (or ask agy) to change or remove anything. Run follow.ps1 -Resume to follow again.
msgMissingTool: {0} is required but was not found. Install it ({1}) and run install again.
msgNotFollowing: Not following the shared repository (follow.ps1 -Resume to follow it again).
msgOldGemini: Your old GEMINI.md is in the backup. To keep any of its rules, ask agy to add them to {0}.
msgOtherClone: This machine is set up from '{0}'. To use this folder ('{1}') instead, run install again with -Reinstall.
msgPersonalMissing: The local copy of your backup repository ({0}) is missing and could not be cloned again: {1}. Check the network and that git can sign in to GitHub, then run install again.
msgPersonalRestored: The local copy of your backup repository was missing; cloned it again into {0}.
msgPlan: This will back up your current agy configuration and install profile '{0}' as {1}. Nothing runs in the background while agy is closed: when agy starts, it checks at most once a week for updates and backs up your configuration.
msgPlanBackup: Your configuration is backed up automatically to {0}.
msgPlanNoBackup: No backup repository: your configuration changes stay on this machine. Run install again with -Reinstall -BackupRepo <url> to add one later.
msgPluginRepaired: The agy-self-config plugin was missing and has been installed again.
msgReinstallHint: To run the full setup again, add -Reinstall.
msgRepoMoved: The repository folder moved from '{0}' to '{1}'. The setup now uses the new folder, so weekly maintenance works again.
msgRestoring: Found a saved configuration in {0}; restoring it.
msgUninstallHint: To remove it later: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "{0}"
msgUninstalled: Removed the agy-self-config plugin (and any scheduled tasks from older versions). Installed skills were left in place, and so was your backup repository. Run install again to set this machine up.
msgWarnTool: Note: {0} was not found ({1}). Some features need it.
promptBackupRepo: URL of your own GitHub repository for automatic backups (create an empty private one first, for example https://github.com/<you>/agy-backup.git). Press Enter to skip
promptLanguage: Which language should agy reply in? Press Enter for auto (the language the user writes in), or type a code such as en, vi, ja
promptProfile: Profile name (existing: {0}). Type an existing name or a new one
promptProjectMap: Project map tool: press Enter for graphify, type the name of another skill you use, or type none
